title: Utilities in the front setback, at the entry or on visible roof areas integrated, accessible and not obtrusive
text: Utilities that must be located within the front setback, adjacent to the building entry or on visible parts of the roof are integrated into the design of the building, landscape and/or fencing such that they are accessible for servicing requirements but not visually obtrusive.
notes: from: ch4p1 C2.5.1; diverges: performance wording ('not visually obtrusive') rather than a screened/integrated statement, so judgment here; services.utilities_integrated (FACTS placeholder) is not used.
